rules.positive_evidence: Always includes 'General' in the candidate pool if absent from Classifier Top-5 & MiniLM Top-5

rules.affected_category: Education, Shopping, Payment, Travel, Coding, Communication, Entertainment, Work & Career, Connectivity
rules.positive_evidence: Exact string match of high-confidence category phrases in lowercased raw OCR text
rules.thresholds: +0.20 for 1 phrase match, +0.35 for >= 2 phrase matches

rules.rule_name: General Penalty when Competing Domain Evidence is Present
rules.negative_evidence: Presence of >= 1 domain phrase match for any non-General candidate in pool
rules.validation_evidence: Reduces false-positive General predictions when explicit domain phrases exist

rules.negative_evidence: Reranked candidate has < 2 domain OCR phrase matches and low visual confidence
rules.thresholds: Restores base Top-1 prediction if reranked candidate lacks strong evidence
rules.validation_evidence: Prevents unevidenced overrides of high-confidence text classifier predictions

rules.rule_name: YOLOv8n-cls Visual Screen Type Evidence Mapping
